claims.label: Frank Turek invoked Exodus 22:22 and Deuteronomy 19 in commentary directed at Candace Owens on Nicholas Bowling's podcast
claims.claim: Frank Turek, on a Nicholas Bowling podcast episode airing roughly Aug 3, 2026, cited Exodus 22:22 and Deuteronomy 19 in commentary accusing Candace Owens of falsely accusing people.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Nicholas Bowling podcast episode audio/transcript to verify the exact wording and surrounding context.

claims.label: Woodworker email states black nitrile gloves are standard resistance to CA glue and adhesive
claims.claim: A woodworker email received by Candace Owens's production states that black nitrile gloves are the most resistant to CA glue (super glue) and spray activator adhesive.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify CA glue / nitrile glove compatibility through woodworking safety data sheets or trade sources.

claims.label: CNN article on Sept 11, 2025 reported screwdriver was found "near the recovered rifle"
claims.claim: A CNN article dated September 11, 2025 stated that authorities recovered a screwdriver near the rifle believed used in the Charlie Kirk shooting, framing the screwdriver as evidence the shooter may have disassembled/reassembled the firearm.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this framing against the later (approx. Sept 15, 2025) Kash Patel / Bongino statement that the screwdriver was on the rooftop; obtain the original CNN article in full.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not review rooftop video between the suspect jumping off and his arrival
claims.claim: During cross-examination, Officer Christopher Bagley testified that he did not review the police department video footage to determine whether anyone else had been on the rooftop between the suspect's jump and his own arrival.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain trial transcripts or full video of Bagley's testimony to confirm wording and any clarification given.

claims.label: Andrew Kovat appeared on Benny Johnson's show from a room at the Asher Adams Hotel in Salt Lake City on Sept 11, 2025
claims.claim: A screenshot displayed from Benny Johnson's show on September 11, 2025 shows Andrew Kovat broadcasting from a room at the Asher Adams (Autograph Collection) Hotel in Salt Lake City.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via hotel guest logs (subject to availability) or via further visual artifacts.

claims.label: Sky News investigation identified Tomahawk missile tail fins in footage of the Iranian school strike
claims.claim: A Sky News investigation, drawing on Iranian state-linked news agency footage, identified Tomahawk missile tail fins in buildings struck during the Iranian school bombing; Sky News also stated a US carrier strike group was within range and that Tomahawks are precision-guided with onboard cameras.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch the full Sky News documentary segment; cross-reference carrier strike group positioning via Pentagon releases.

claims.label: Mark Levin publicly called for arming Iranian protesters
claims.claim: Mark Levin, in a played audio segment, urged arming Iranian protesters and referenced testimony from a protest leader describing Iranian streets running "red with blood."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original Levin broadcast (date, program) for full context.

claims.label: Blake Neff publicly accused Candace Owens of harassing a random Utah police officer
claims.claim: Blake Neff posted on X accusing Candace Owens of harassing "another random Utah police officer," accusing her of seeking dirt on him via former Marines, and characterizing her work as harassment for her "grift."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Neff's exact X post URL to confirm timestamp and surrounding context.

claims.label: Daily Mail press request asked Candace Owens about contingency planning in case of a law enforcement raid
claims.claim: The Daily Mail, in a press request received by Candace Owens's team on or about Aug 3, 2026, asked what steps she is taking "if the worst happens and you are raided by law enforcement."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Daily Mail editorial record or correspondence log.

claims.label: Host states her team fact-checked the woodworker email claim and verified its accuracy
claims.claim: Candace Owens states her team looked up and verified the woodworker's email claim that black nitrile gloves are the standard resistance to CA glue/spray activator, characterizing it as "100% true."
claims.investigative_direction: Request the team's fact-check documentation; cross-reference with independent woodworking/safety sources.

claims.label: Some Catholic funeral homes in Arizona offer cremation services, contrary to standard Catholic doctrine
claims.claim: Candace Owens states that, contrary to Catholic doctrine prohibiting cremation, certain Catholic funeral homes in Arizona do in fact offer cremation services; she confirmed this via her own lookup.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with the Diocese of Phoenix / Catholic Diocese of Arizona guidelines and named funeral homes.

claims.label: Host identifies show community as Decentralized Intelligence Agency
claims.claim: The host states that the show / audience operates as the Decentralized Intelligence Agency (or close variant), a crowd-sourced tip network opposing centralized intel.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...lligent agency hats, our CIA hats, but we are the decentralized intelligence agency. Yeah, that one. The green one's my favorite. The hunter green one is the one that I wear around to...

claims.label: CIA hat merch framed as Candace / Decentralized Intelligence Agency brand
claims.claim: The host plugs CIA-branded merch (hat/line) and glosses it as Candace Intelligence Agency and/or the Decentralized Intelligence Agency twin brand.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm on-screen merch graphic if available; reuse M-14 when exact Candace Intelligence Agency phrase airs.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...y a shirt to support us, a sweatshirt. Our iconic Candace intelligent agency hats, our CIA hats, but we are the decentralized intelligence agency. Yeah, that one. The green one's my...

claims.label: Host Says Turek Is Trending on X for Using the Bible to Say She Should Be Struck Down
claims.claim: The host says Frank Turek is going viral and trending on X for seemingly using the Bible to message that she should be struck down, and that it is not the first time he has done so.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture the Turek post or podcast clip and X trending data for 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-04 to confirm the trend and the wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: Frank Turk is actually going viral right now, trending on X for seemingly using the Bible to message that I should be struck down.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Accuses Her of Putting Innocent Lives at Risk
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff claims she is putting innocent lives at risk, and she replies that he does so himself by continually calling for Tyler Robinson's conviction in the absence of evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Neff's X post making the 'innocent lives at risk' statement and compare it with his public statements on the Robinson case.
claims.transcript_snippet: But no, Blakey says I'm putting innocent lives at risk. Really? How?

claims.label: Host Says Yesterday's Episode Solved Who Was on the Rooftop With Officer Bagley
claims.claim: The host says that at the end of the previous episode her team solved the mystery of who was on the rooftop at the Losee Center with Officer Bagley, and that Neff did not thank her for it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's identification of the companion in episode 136 with Bagley's testimony and the 12:47 PM bystander footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: for having solved the mystery of who was on the rooftop at Loy Center with Officer Bagley.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was on a Corporate Zoom Call Laughing at Emojis Within Six Days
claims.claim: In a sarcastic list of the public-relations story the host says she is being asked to accept, she states that Erika Kirk took over the entire company and was on a corporate Zoom call laughing at emojis within six days of her husband's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the video or screenshots of the TPUSA corporate Zoom call and its date to test the six-day claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: is on a corporate Zoom call laughing at emojis within six days of her husband's public assassination?

claims.label: Turek Says the Lies and Slander After Kirk's Death Are Demonic and Names Candace Owens
claims.claim: In the Nicholas Bowling podcast clip, Frank Turek says that since Charlie Kirk was murdered there have been lies, accusations and slander, calls this spiritual warfare and demonic activity, and says he is talking about Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Nicholas Bowling podcast audio to confirm the wording and who spoke each line.
claims.transcript_snippet: This is spiritual warfare. This is demonic activity. >> Yeah. I'm talking about Candace Owens.

claims.label: Turek Says Owens Insinuates Murder Accusations Without Evidence
claims.claim: In the podcast clip, Frank Turek says Candace Owens accuses or insinuates that people are guilty of murder without evidence 'left and right' and calls that evil.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Turek's characterization with the host's actual statements about named individuals across the series.
claims.transcript_snippet: You don't accuse people of murder without evidence, but that's what she's doing left and right. She's insinuating it left and right.

claims.label: Host Says the Prosecution Side Never Showed Video of the Shot, a Gun Link or the Screwdriver Drop
claims.claim: The host says the bar was low: all that was needed was video of Tyler Robinson taking the shot, a connection of the gun to the crime scene, or video of him dropping the screwdriver and assembling the gun on the rooftop, and none of this has been shown.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the preliminary hearing exhibit list and discovery for any footage of the shooting or evidence linking the rifle to the scene.
claims.transcript_snippet: All they had to do uh, was show us the video of him taking the shot. All they had to do was somehow connect the gun to the crime scene.

claims.label: Host Says the Claim That Robinson's Parents Turned Him In Was Never Backed With Evidence
claims.claim: The host says that, from the beginning, the claim that Tyler Robinson's parents turned him in was never shown, and that instead the public heard a story about 'Mitch Mitchell', whom she describes as an undercover officer his entire life, pressuring Robinson to come in peacefully or officers would knock in the doors.
claims.investigative_direction: Check court filings and the Washington County statements for the surrender sequence and for who contacted Robinson's parents and the pastor.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nothing they have said since the very beginning. Tyler Robinson's parents turned them in. Had they showed us that? Nope.

claims.label: Host Says the Claim Robinson Was in a Relationship With a Transgender Person Has Not Checked Out
claims.claim: The host says people have lied about Tyler Robinson at every stage, including by describing him as transgender or in a relationship with a transgender person, and that this has not checked out.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare official statements and hearing testimony about Robinson's relationship with the host's characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: including by describing him as a a transgendered or or being in a relationship with somebody that's transgendered. That hasn't checked out.

claims.label: Host Says the Boyfriend's Testimony Was That Robinson Was Not Political and Never Discussed Kirk
claims.claim: The host says testimony from Tyler Robinson's boyfriend was that Robinson was not into politics and that they never discussed Charlie Kirk in their relationship, which she contrasts with the claim of a politically motivated murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary hearing transcript of the roommate or partner testimony and check the exact words on politics and Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: We heard testimony from his boyfriend who says, "No, he wasn't into politics. We never discussed Charlie Kirk ever in our relationship.

claims.label: Host Says There Is More Evidence Kirk Was Killed by an Exploding Mic Than by Robinson From the Rooftop
claims.claim: The host says that, from where she sits, there is currently more evidence that Charlie Kirk was killed by an exploding microphone than that he was shot from the Losee rooftop by Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: List the host's evidence for the microphone theory and the prosecution's exhibits for the rooftop shot and compare them side by side.
claims.transcript_snippet: there is currently more evidence that Charlie Kirk was killed from an exploding mic than there is that he was shot from uh Loy Rooftop by Tyler Robinson.

claims.label: Host Says Turek Said He Stuck His Fingers Into Kirk's Neck and Tasted Blood
claims.claim: The host says Frank Turek told the public he stuck his fingers into Charlie Kirk's neck, had blood all over him and could taste it in his mouth, and asks when he would have put on black nitrile gloves.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Turek's original interview or retelling and confirm the exact words about his fingers and the blood.
claims.transcript_snippet: Frank told us he stuck his fingers right into Charlie's neck. He had blood all over him. He could taste it in his mouth.

claims.label: Host Says the Unreleased 911 Call Has Voices in the Back Saying to Get Something Off Him
claims.claim: The host says her team broke the story that the still-unreleased 911 call captures people in the back of the vehicle saying 'Get that off of him', and she floats that this could relate to the gloves.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 911 call audio and CAD record from Utah County dispatch and check for the phrase and the speakers.
claims.transcript_snippet: We've also broke the story that the 911 call, which is yet to be released. They hear them in the back saying, "Get that off of him.

claims.label: Host Recalls John Bray Showed the Road Microphone Glass Is Very Sticky
claims.claim: The host says John Bray showed that the glass for the road microphone is very sticky, and that woodworkers use black nitrile gloves to handle superglue because adhesive wipes off easily.
claims.investigative_direction: Review John Bray's earlier demonstration and the microphone's materials to see whether the adhesive claim holds.
claims.transcript_snippet: Remember John Bray showed us that that glass for the road mic is very, very, very sticky.

claims.label: Host Says Senator Mike Lee Was Slated to Attend the September 10 UVU Event
claims.claim: The host says Utah Senator Mike Lee was slated to attend the Charlie Kirk event at Utah Valley University on September 10, and that this is not unusual because local politicians and donors often come to say a few words.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Senator Lee's office and TPUSA for the event invitation list and whether Lee was ever confirmed as an attendee.
claims.transcript_snippet: Senator Lee was actually slated to attend the Charlie Kirk event at UVU on September 10th.

claims.label: Host Says Lee Cancelled Early That Week Because of NDAA Votes
claims.claim: The host says that, as the DC story goes, Senator Lee cancelled early in the week because votes on the National Defense Authorization Act were taking place in Washington, and that TPUSA knew he was coming.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Senate schedule and NDAA floor votes for the week of September 8, 2025 and any Lee office statement about the cancellation.
claims.transcript_snippet: that week the senator had to cancel very early on in the week due to the National Defense Authorization Act

claims.label: Host Gives Background on Mike Lee's Birth and Father
claims.claim: The host says Mike Lee was born in Arizona, spent most of his upbringing in Utah and comes from a well-to-do family, with a father who was founding dean of BYU's law school program.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Lee's official biography for his birthplace and his father's role at BYU Law.
claims.transcript_snippet: His father was actually the founding dean of BYU's law school program.

claims.label: Host Says Her UVU Source Says Lee Was Contacted After the Assassination About Something Unusual the Day Before
claims.claim: The host says a source who talked to UVU told her that after the assassination Mike Lee was contacted because of something unusual that took place on campus the day before the shooting, after he had already cancelled.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask UVU police and Senator Lee's office whether Lee's office was contacted after September 10, 2025 about a campus incident and what was said.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've got a source that UVU tells me that after the assassination of Charlie, Mike Lee was contacted due to something unusual that took place on campus the day before the shooting.

claims.label: Host Says a Suspicious Person on UVU Campus on September 9 Told Security He Was Lee's Bodyguard
claims.claim: The host says that on September 9 a person who looked suspicious and appeared to be scoping out the UVU campus was approached by security and said he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard checking the area ahead of the event, and was let go.
claims.investigative_direction: Request UVU security and police incident logs, radio traffic and any field-contact record for September 9, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: he told the campus security that he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard, scoping out the area to ensure that the senator was going to be safe ahead of the event.

claims.label: Host Says Lee's Office Had Already Cancelled and Lee Has No Security Team
claims.claim: The host says Lee's office had already cancelled by the time of the September 9 incident, and that her own digging suggests Lee does not have a security apparatus or team, so the bodyguard story was untrue.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Lee's Senate office whether any staff or security accompanied him to Utah events in September 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I have done some digging and it also appears that Mike Lee is pretty down to earth. He doesn't actually have a security apparatus, a security team.

claims.label: Host Says the Scoper Knew Enough to Offer a Plausible Cover Story and That Few People Had the Attendee List
claims.claim: The host says the person on campus had enough information to give a legitimate-sounding excuse, and that only a small group would have known the attendee list, a group she argues would not include Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who at TPUSA, UVU and campus clubs had access to the attendee list before September 9.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was only a small group of people who would have been privy to that knowledge, who would have been privy of the attendee list.

claims.label: Host Lists Who Would Have Known Lee's Attendance and Says No Footage of the Man Is Known
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA event staff, club students, university planners and possibly UVU police would have known who was attending, and says no footage of the man who scoped the campus the day before has been mentioned.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask UVU for camera coverage of the September 9 contact and a list of everyone who received the VIP attendee list.
claims.transcript_snippet: Certainly Turning Point USA event staff would have known. Club students would have known.

claims.label: Host Quotes Neff Saying She Suggests the Officer Moved to Utah a Year Before and Earlier Targeted a Sergeant
claims.claim: The host reads Neff's post as saying she suggests it is suspicious that the officer moved to Utah a year before Charlie's shooting, and that she earlier went after a police sergeant two weeks before and then got bored.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Neff's exact X post to confirm the sergeant and move-date wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: suggests that is suspiciously timed that he moved to Utah a year before Charlie's shooting

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA-Side Accounts Are Calling for Her Home to Be Raided Over the Rooftop Video
claims.claim: The host says people on TPUSA's platform are calling for her home to be raided for sharing the video of the man on the rooftop who looks like he has military experience.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific posts calling for a raid of the host's home and who amplified them.
claims.transcript_snippet: posting people on your platform that are calling for my home to be raided for sharing the video of the guy who certainly looks like he's got some military experience on the rooftop.

claims.label: Host Says the Daily Mail Request Concerned the Rooftop Footage Her Team Released
claims.claim: The host says the Daily Mail press request arrived the day before and was about the footage her team released of the rooftop man tactically crawling across the Losee Center and jumping off like Spider-Man.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Daily Mail request email to confirm date, sender and the full question list.
claims.transcript_snippet: we actually received a press request from the Daily Mail yesterday regarding the footage that we released of the rooftop man

claims.label: Host Says Bongino, Patel, Erika Kirk and TPUSA Publicly Promised Transparency and Not Editing Videos
claims.claim: The host says the consistent public messaging from Dan Bongino, Kash Patel, Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA was that they wanted nothing but transparency, did not edit the videos and did not lie about the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect each named person's public transparency statements and test them against what has been released.
claims.transcript_snippet: Dan Bonino, Kash Patel, Erika Kirk, Turning Point USA. We didn't edit the videos. We don't lie about what was on the footage.

claims.label: Host Says the Screwdriver Story Began With a Law Enforcement Leak Placing It Near the Rifle
claims.claim: The host says the screwdriver story surfaced less than 24 hours after the assassination through a law enforcement leak to the press, and the initial leak said it was found near the rifle rather than on the Losee rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the September 11, 2025 reports and their anonymous law-enforcement sources, and compare them with later official accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: We learned about the screwdriver because someone in law enforcement leaked information to the press.

claims.label: Host Says Public Backlash Followed the CNN Screwdriver Story and Patel and Bongino Clarified Four Days Later It Was on the Rooftop
claims.claim: The host says blue-collar readers revolted against the CNN screwdriver story, and that four days later Kash Patel and Dan Bongino clarified that the footage is grainy but the screwdriver was found on the rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the September 15, 2025 Patel and Bongino statements and compare them with the September 11 CNN wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: 4 days later we hear from Kash Patel and Dan Bonino and they clarify that you know the footage is grainy uh but the screwdriver was actually found on the rooftop

claims.label: Host Says Bagley's Body Cam Died Without the Expected Warning Beeps or Red Flashing
claims.claim: The host says Officer Bagley's body cam died seemingly without warning at the right time, and that there should have been beeping or flashing red before it shut off.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the body cam model's warning-behavior specification and the Axon audit log for Bagley's device.
claims.transcript_snippet: his body cam dies seemingly without warning at exactly the right time. And there's a ton of warning that should have been happening.

claims.label: Bagley Testified He First Saw the Suspect Jump Off the Building When He Reviewed Video at the Police Department
claims.claim: In the played testimony, Officer Bagley says people were up on the roof looking for an individual who ran north, and that it was not until he went to the police department and saw the video that he knew the individual had jumped off the building.
